SOURCE AND ASSESSMENT SCOPE
The available recording ends after Michael Tooley’s closing remarks. A contemporary account also describes a closing statement by John Lennox, which is absent from the versions located. This assessment covers the available recording; neither speaker is penalized for material or replies missing from it.
